note: Donley County TX publishes no zoning district layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. City of Clarendon (county seat) has a zoning ordinance (eCode360 Chapter 14, districts R-1, R-2, B, I) but no GIS or ArcGIS service or zoning map polygons found. Hedley and Howardwick: no zoning or GIS found. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Donley County zoning returned nothing. Only commercial parcel products (Regrid, Dynamo, Acres) exist, not public services.
